usageNotes: Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to bring an offline Proxmox node back up. The target node must have WoL enabled in its BIOS/UEFI and the network interface must support it; the API call is made against a currently online node that forwards the magic packet on behalf of the offline one. Returns the MAC address that was used to construct the packet — useful for confirming the correct NIC was targeted.

examples.summary: Wake an offline node named 'pve2' via WoL

tips: This endpoint is called on an online node (e.g. pve1) to wake a peer node (pve2) — not on the offline node itself.
The MAC address in the response reflects what Proxmox has configured for that node's WoL NIC; verify it matches the physical NIC in the BIOS if WoL silently fails.
WoL requires the offline node to be on the same broadcast domain (L2 segment) as the sending node or a properly configured directed broadcast.
